transcript: Speaker A: I want job, but my English not good. Speaker B: Do you want to learn spoken English? Speaker A: Haan, par kya aap Kannada mein samjha sakte ho? [Yes, but can you explain in Kannada?] Speaker B: Bilkul, kya aap English bolna seekhna chahti hai? [Absolutely, do you want to learn to speak English?] Speaker A: Haan, lekin coaching ke liye mere paas paise nahi hai. [Yes, but I don't have money for coaching.] Speaker B: Koi problem nahi, bas SpeakEasy app try kijiye aur roz sirf 10 se 15 minute practice kijiye. [No problem, just try the SpeakEasy app and practice for only 10 to 15 minutes daily.] Speaker A: Par mujhe sikhaye ga kaun? [But who will teach me?] Speaker B: Mere jaise AI teacher aapko daily practice karwayegi, mistakes correct karegi, aur confidence build karegi. [An AI teacher like me will make you practice daily, correct your mistakes, and build your confidence.] Speaker A: Sunne mein to bahut easy lag raha hai. [Sounds very easy.] Speaker B: Lakho users yahan practice kar rahe hain. Sirf ek rupaye mein trial start kijiye aur apni English improve kijiye. [Lakhs of users are practicing here. Start your trial for just one rupee and improve your English.] Speaker C: Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
